records.title: Native screen job and hierarchy
records.guidance: Name the concrete user job, primary action, content order, and platform presentation surface before visual changes.
records.benefit: Makes the screen easier to understand.
records.validation: Every existing action is represented in the hierarchy and behavior contract.

records.title: One product-specific native interaction
records.guidance: Use at most one signature interaction that improves feedback or continuity, then critique it before and after implementation.
records.benefit: Adds identity without visual noise.
records.validation: The interaction has a user-benefit rationale and reduced-motion fallback.

records.title: Semantic mobile scales
records.guidance: Consolidate observed raw values into semantic color, type, spacing, shape, motion, target, and state roles.
records.benefit: Improves consistency and accessibility across screens.
records.validation: Typed native adapters expose complete semantic parity.

records.title: Adaptive and accessible mobile priority
records.guidance: Prioritize semantics, text scaling, RTL, keyboard, safe areas, touch targets, and compact-to-tablet layout.
records.benefit: Makes production flows usable by more people and devices.
records.validation: Automated coverage includes the supported accessibility and adaptive matrix.

records.title: Evidence-backed mobile Design Read
records.guidance: Separate observed product language into preserve, improve, and uncertain decisions before redesign.
records.benefit: Protects existing identity and behavior.
records.validation: Every decision cites current code or an explicit uncertainty.

records.title: Native density, motion, and variance dials
records.guidance: Set explicit density, contrast, shape, typography, motion, and variance dials and reject decoration without user benefit.
records.benefit: Creates coherent, restrained visual direction.
records.validation: Dials map to native tokens or behavior and retain accessibility.

records.title: Platform-neutral component intent
records.guidance: Select a component contract by intent, required states, semantics, and adaptive behavior before choosing a native primitive.
records.benefit: Reuses design knowledge without importing incompatible code.
records.validation: The selected primitive belongs to the target framework.

records.title: Optional React Native registry boundary
records.guidance: Use compatible registry metadata only for React Native discovery; map the same intent independently for Flutter, SwiftUI, and Compose.
records.benefit: Keeps every platform native and dependency-free.
records.validation: Non-React targets contain no React implementation or dependency.

records.title: Context to native component plan
records.guidance: Convert request and code evidence into intent, constraints, alternatives, selection, integration, and refinement.
records.benefit: Produces product-specific native components locally.
records.validation: The plan includes behavior invariants and bounded file scope.

records.title: Native integration refinement
records.guidance: Refine the selected native composition against existing tokens, architecture, semantics, motion, and verification.
records.benefit: Turns an idea into a safe implementation contract.
records.validation: Only approved UI files change and a guard receipt is produced.

records.title: Reactive state ownership
records.guidance: Keep state at its current owner, derive presentation values, preserve event ownership, and use immutable updates.
records.benefit: Avoids stale UI and behavior regressions.
records.validation: State-transition and interaction tests remain unchanged.

records.title: Stable identity and render boundary
records.guidance: Preserve stable collection identity and isolate expensive presentation only where project evidence supports it.
records.benefit: Keeps selection, focus, and scrolling reliable.
records.validation: Representative interaction state survives updates and redesign.

records.title: Labeled native motion sequence
records.guidance: Model multi-phase motion with named states, labels, timing, interruption, and a stable resting state through native APIs.
records.benefit: Makes coordinated motion predictable and maintainable.
records.validation: Rapid interaction and screen teardown leave the UI in a valid state.

records.title: Bounded native stagger and lifecycle
records.guidance: Cap stagger, bind animation ownership to screen lifecycle, and remove stagger and travel for reduced motion.
records.benefit: Adds rhythm without delaying interaction or causing leaks.
records.validation: Performance budget, cancellation, cleanup, and reduced-motion tests pass.

records.title: Native variants and presence
records.guidance: Represent visual variants as typed UI state and map entrance and exit to native transitions.
records.benefit: Keeps motion synchronized with product state.
records.validation: Every variant has an accessible resting representation.

records.title: Native gesture and shared continuity
records.guidance: Use native press or drag recognition, explicit cancellation, and shared transitions only with stable identity.
records.benefit: Makes touch and navigation continuity understandable.
records.validation: System gestures, cancellation, reduced motion, and accessible alternatives are covered.

records.title: Typed async presentation contract
records.guidance: Render typed loading, empty, error, retry, and populated states without importing backend internals.
records.benefit: Makes recovery clear while keeping presentation testable.
records.validation: All states render without a live backend.

records.title: Small app-facing data boundary
records.guidance: Keep repository, service, auth, and environment ownership outside reusable visual components.
records.benefit: Lets UI change without destabilizing data or security behavior.
records.validation: Protected calls, types, permissions, and auth boundaries remain unchanged.

records.title: Native navigation, list, image, and modal quality
records.guidance: Apply measured native lessons for navigation, virtualization, images, modals, safe areas, text scaling, and performance.
records.benefit: Improves production reliability across mobile frameworks.
records.validation: Native route, list, image, inset, and accessibility tests pass.

records.title: React Native and Expo depth with native parity
records.guidance: Use API-specific React Native and Expo rules only when detected, and translate only their platform-neutral product lesson elsewhere.
records.benefit: Provides deep React Native support without false portability.
records.validation: Every generated API belongs to the detected framework and Expo rules are conditional.
